d1m1-role.hook: You own **the file's movement**; Atty. Thorne owns every legal judgment.

Log every contact, deadline and decision **in the CMS**
Each phase has **its own goals and deliverables**
Flag risk to Atty. Thorne **the day you see it**
d1m1-role.upl: Explain the process and confirm facts; never value, merits or settlement advice
dos: Keep **a dated next step** on every file
Answer process questions; **route the legal ones**
donts: Guessing **what the case is worth**
Keeping the status **in your inbox**, not the CMS

ruleEx.rule: The first line of every note to Atty. Thorne is **the decision and its deadline**; the subject line says it too
ruleEx.exception: Nothing to decide? Say so first: **'FYI, no action needed'**, then the facts

redFlag.see: A note to Atty. Thorne with **'Update'** as its subject line

d1m1-case.hook: One file for five days: know **its facts cold** before you touch the CMS.
points: Who ran the stop, and where John sat: **the Police Report**
The stack, in order: **BI → Host UM → Relative UM**, $40,000
His seat in the vehicle decides **which layers he reaches**
EMS date vs. first treatment record: **find the gap yourself**
d1m1-case.upl: Share facts and the process; never value, or what the gap does
dos: Trace every fact **to its document**
Say the stack **in order**, every time
donts: Repeating facts **from memory** alone
Treating the gap as **the client's fault**

redFlag.see: A Case Snapshot field with no named source document, even **the client's seat**
redFlag.costs: An unverified field becomes the file's fact, and a wrong seat reaches the wrong policies
redFlag.do: Name each field's document (RS01, RS07); mark the rest **not yet verified**

steps: Run and log **the Conflict Check** on full legal names
Verify every draft field **against its source document**
Correct each error **with its source**, never silently
Docket **SOL 02/06/2028**, map six roles, file intake documents
Route **a correction note** to Atty. Thorne in Case Notes
d1m1-open.deliver: An active matter, **every field verified**, corrections noted to Atty. Thorne
d1m1-open.purpose: A file opened wrong stays wrong: **every later step** trusts this record
d1m1-open.principle: The signed source document wins; **the draft is only a lead**
checks: Conflict Check logged **before the matter existed**
Position corrected **from the Police Report**
Date of birth and **report number** corrected, with sources
SOL docketed; **six roles** mapped; documents filed
Correction note **routed to Atty. Thorne**
dos: Verify against **signed documents**, not the draft
donts: Accepting **a pre-filled field** unchecked

d1m1-drive.situation: 02/09/2026, 4:30 p.m. John Doe's matter is **active in the CMS**, and nothing is on **the firm's backup drive** yet.
steps: Press **🔗 Link my Google Drive** on the Backup File Maintenance slide
Build the hierarchy **to the firm standard**, by hand
Name, number, nest and order **the whole hierarchy**
Confirm it with **✓ Check my drive**
Place **retainer, Police Report, HIPAA** in Case Notes
d1m1-drive.deliver: A linked drive **built to standard**, confirmed by a clean check
d1m1-drive.purpose: A covering Case Manager must **find any document in seconds**
d1m1-drive.principle: Every file is laid out **the same way, every time**
checks: Drive linked with **drive.file only**
Every folder **named and numbered** to the standard
**Doe-John** under 01 Clients, nine folders inside
**✓ Check my drive**: no folder missing
Three documents **placed, with reasons**
dos: Run **✓ Check my drive** whenever you file
donts: A folder named **“Misc”** that nobody opens

BI third-party; **both UM layers first-party**
Relative UM adjuster: **“No adjuster assigned yet”**, not blank

roadmap.title: The No Contact Protocol: the Roadmap

steps.label: Internal review
steps.text: Case status, live deadlines, last contact, channels used

steps.label: Contact attempts
steps.text: Phone twice, email and text, emergency contact, **certified mail**

steps.label: Log every attempt
steps.text: Date, time, channel and outcome, in the CMS

steps.label: Team notification
steps.text: Escalate to Atty. Thorne with **the deadline impact**

d1m2-l1.hook: A client you can't reach **still has deadlines**; the protocol proves the firm did its part.
points: Step 1: review status, deadlines and last contact **before you call**
Step 2: **2+ phone attempts**, email and text, emergency contact, certified mail
Escalate **by channel, not by volume**; log every attempt as made
Step 3: notify the attorney and **assess SOL and hearing dates**
d1m2-l1.upl: Say what the firm needs, by when; never advise on rights or threaten withdrawal
dos: Set a **follow-up reminder** as each request goes out
Offer **an easy way to respond**: call, text, upload link
donts: Letting a file sit **without logging attempts**
Blaming the client for **process gaps**

ruleEx.rule: Escalate **by channel, not by volume**: every attempt logged with date, time, channel and outcome
ruleEx.exception: The emergency contact gets **a message, never the case**: 'Please have John call us by 02/18/2026.'
ruleEx.onFile: Margaret Doe reached 02/16/2026, 11:05 a.m.; no case details shared
ruleEx.confirm: Atty. Thorne decides what follows Step 3

redFlag.see: Voicemails left **02/11 and 02/13** that never reached the Communications Log
redFlag.costs: An unlogged attempt did not happen: the ladder can't show the attempts were made
redFlag.do: Log each attempt now **with date, time, channel and outcome**

d1m2-a1.situation: John Doe has been silent **six days**: a missed check-in, no treatment yet, two unlogged voicemails. **An emergency contact** is on file.
steps: Step 1: **name the live deadlines** before any outreach
Log the two earlier voicemails with **date, time, channel**
Carry the ladder forward: email, SMS, **emergency contact**
Record **the next action** with its due date
Decide whether **Step 3 notification** is warranted, and the impact
d1m2-a1.deliver: A Step 1 review and an **unbroken, contemporaneous** Step 2 outreach log
d1m2-a1.purpose: With the SOL running and treatment unstarted, **an unlogged attempt** never happened
d1m2-a1.principle: Review the deadlines first; **a new channel** beats a repeat call
checks: Step 1 review done **before any outreach**
**Every entry**: date, time, channel, outcome
Email and SMS attempted, **not repeat calls**
Impact names **SOL 02/06/2028** and treatment not started
No entry **threatens withdrawal** or closure
dos: Write each entry as if **audited six months from now**
donts: Logging **“called client, no answer”** with no details
Counting three calls to one mobile **as three channels**

d1m2-l2.hook: The Final Warning Letter is **the last low-cost step** before search or withdrawal.
points: Step 4: send by **certified mail AND email**, to a confirmed address
State earlier attempts, **a 7–14 day deadline**, and notice of potential withdrawal
Skip-Trace needs **all three**: ladder exhausted, letter sent, deadline passed
Withdrawal and skip-tracing are **counsel's decisions**; keep the file moving
d1m2-l2.upl: Never judge the claim or advise on rights; only the attorney ends representation
dos: Itemize **attempts with dates**
Ask in-house help to **confirm an address**
donts: Skip-tracing on **the first criterion alone**
Writing **“we are withdrawing”** without attorney approval

steps.label: Final Warning Letter
steps.done: Attempts itemized; **a response date** as a date; certified mail and email

steps.label: Atty. Thorne decides
steps.done: His decision logged; **only he tells John**

steps.label: File closure
steps.done: Closed with **the proof of every step** retained

ruleEx.rule: **Withdrawal is possible, never announced**: the letter says it may happen, not that it will
ruleEx.exception: None: **only Atty. Thorne decides**, and tells John, that representation is ending
ruleEx.confirm: Atty. Thorne decides and tells John

redFlag.see: A draft letter saying **'we are withdrawing'** or 'you will lose your case'
redFlag.costs: It announces a decision only Atty. Thorne can make, and predicts the claim
redFlag.do: Strike it; **send the draft to Atty. Thorne** for review before it goes

d1m2-a2.situation: John Doe, unreachable **eleven days**: phone, email, texts and emergency contact all tried, logged. Step 3 escalation made to Atty. Thorne. **Treatment still hasn't begun**.
steps: Itemize **the earlier attempts** with dates
Set a response deadline **inside 7–14 days**, as a date
Give **notice of potential withdrawal** and how to respond
Keep every line **inside the UPL boundary**
Record the Skip-Trace criteria and **Atty. Thorne's Step 5 authority**
d1m2-a2.deliver: A **send-ready Final Warning Letter**, both deliveries logged, escalation recorded
d1m2-a2.purpose: This letter is **the last notice** before Atty. Thorne decides on withdrawal
d1m2-a2.principle: State facts, a dated deadline and how to respond; **never legal consequences**
checks: **DOL 02/06/2026** and file reference present
Deadline is **a date inside 7–14 days**
Withdrawal noted **as possible, not decided**
**Certified mail AND email** both recorded
No statement on **value or legal consequences**
dos: Be **urgent without threatening**: what's needed, by when
donts: A deadline of **“as soon as possible”**
Writing **“you will lose your case”**

questions: Set out all **six No Contact Protocol steps** in order, with each step's required action.
State the protocol's **three purposes**. Which one protects the firm rather than the client?
A colleague calls **three voicemails to one mobile** an exhausted ladder. What's wrong; what should the log show?

steps.label: Give the instructions
steps.text: No Recorded Statement, no posts, no signing without review

steps.label: Treatment and barriers
steps.text: Keep every appointment; **report any barrier** before a miss

steps.label: Keep the receipts
steps.text: Every expense and mile documented, so it can be claimed

steps.label: The PD carve-out
steps.text: The adverse carrier may discuss **Property Damage only**

d1m3-l1.hook: Most self-inflicted claim damage happens **in the first two weeks**, before the client is told.
d1m3-l1.whyLine: Most self-inflicted claim damage happens **in the first two weeks**.
points: **No Recorded Statement** to the adverse carrier; route contact through the firm
Start treatment and **keep every appointment**
**Post nothing**, sign nothing from a carrier until the firm reviews it
Keep **every receipt** and a log of each trip to treatment
d1m3-l1.upl: Give the instruction; route questions about claim value to Atty. Thorne
dos: Ask about **barriers to care** at every check-in
Use **active listening**; heard clients follow instructions
donts: Explaining why a Recorded Statement hurts: **that's legal advice**
Letting a carrier's Property Damage call **drift into injuries**

ruleEx.rule: After notice, **the adverse carrier talks to the firm**, not to John: no Recorded Statement
ruleEx.exception: **Property Damage only**, with the vehicle's owner: Keystone PD (Leah Moran) deals with Margaret Doe about the Civic
ruleEx.onFile: Notice to Dana Whitfield 02/10/2026, after Keystone called John on 02/09
ruleEx.confirm: Injury questions route to Atty. Thorne

redFlag.see: Dana Whitfield (Keystone) asked John Doe **to record his account** (his voicemail, 02/10/2026, 8:47 a.m.)
redFlag.costs: A represented client's recorded account becomes Keystone's evidence on the 14-Day Gap
redFlag.do: Send written notice today: no direct contact; **statements go through the firm**. Log it.

d1m3-a1.situation: John Doe's voicemail: **Keystone asked to record him**, his neck is stiff, and **nothing has reached him** from the firm.

Email Dana Whitfield: **no direct contact**; statements through the firm
Call John: his neck, **treatment status**, next steps, no outside talk
Coordinate his first visit **with Riverton Urgent Care**
Send the **Direction Packet**; log every contact in the CMS
d1m3-a1.deliver: A graded plan, both emails sent, the call taken, **the packet logged**
d1m3-a1.purpose: The other side **has already called him**: today's plan stops the next call
d1m3-a1.principle: Recorded Statements are requested **through the firm**, never from the client
checks: Transcript and **action plan** handed in
Dana told in writing: **no direct contact**
His neck and **treatment status** checked; next steps given
Riverton Urgent Care contacted; **Direction Packet** logged
No Recorded Statement, no outside talk: **he repeated it**
dos: Tell the carrier **in writing**, not only John
donts: Telling Dana **anything about his injuries**

d1m3-l2.hook: The Civic is Margaret's claim; for John Doe, PD is **evidence of the impact**.
points: Read **the Police Report's units** first: who rode, who owns
Photos, estimate and supplement **feed the BI claim** as evidence
Rental, Loss of Use, Diminished Value **stay on Margaret's claim**
The rental's last day reaches his care: **calendar and coordinate**
d1m3-l2.upl: Sort and refer; never advise Margaret Doe or **value her PD claim**
dos: Ask of every PD fact: **does it touch our case**?
Index photos and estimates **the day they arrive**
donts: Opening **a rental claim in John's name**
Treating Property Damage as **“just the car”**

ruleEx.exception: A PD date that reaches his care goes on John's calendar: **the rental's last covered day**
ruleEx.onFile: The rental ends 03/19/2026; his rides are planned before it

redFlag.see: A rental, PD or Loss of Use claim **opened in John Doe's name**
redFlag.costs: John has no PD claim: Margaret Doe's Civic claim (KM-26-440871-PD) tangles with his BI file
redFlag.do: Keep PD under Margaret Doe; **refer her claim** to Atty. Thorne

d1m3-a2.situation: John Doe's onboarding packet is **delivered and logged**. The directions must now become **tracked obligations**, not a document sent once.
steps: Turn each direction into **a tracked task**
Set **owner, due date and verification** for each
Find **the mis-assigned card** and reassign it
Record why it **could never be the client's**
Schedule the **treatment-start follow-up**
d1m3-a2.deliver: A tracked task set with **correct owners, dates and verification**
d1m3-a2.purpose: Untracked directions are hopes; **tracked tasks** expose a Treatment Gap the day it starts
d1m3-a2.principle: Every task needs **an owner, a date and proof** it happened
checks: Every task has **an owner and due date**
**Verification method** recorded for each task
Mis-assigned card **reassigned to the firm**
**Reason for reassignment** recorded
**Treatment-start follow-up** scheduled
dos: Ask of every task: **how will you know**?
donts: Tracking tasks **without confirming they were done**

d1m3-a3.situation: 02/11/2026: Keystone PD asks **who the Civic's claimant is**. Six PD items wait in the tray, and John Doe asks **if the rental is his**.
steps: Read **the Police Report's units** before sorting anything
Sort each item: **BI evidence, coordinate, or Margaret's**
Index the evidence on John Doe's file in **CMS → Documents**
Refer Margaret's questions to **Atty. Thorne** in CMS → Tasks
End the Case Note with **the one-line answer**
d1m3-a3.deliver: A sorted Case Note ending in **one line: does PD touch our case?**
d1m3-a3.purpose: Sorting first keeps **Margaret's PD claim** off John Doe's file
d1m3-a3.principle: PD touches our case **as evidence, never as his claim**
checks: Who rode and who owns, **from the Police Report**
Photos, tow record, Police Report **indexed as BI evidence**
Rental, Loss of Use, repair figure **left on Margaret's claim**
Rental's last day **set to be calendared**; rides planned
Note ends with **the one-line answer**
dos: **Sort before you act**: the records say whose
donts: Handling **Margaret's Loss of Use** on John Doe's file

questions: List the firm's **standing instructions** for a new client, and the harm each prevents.
Name two PD items that **feed John Doe's claim** and two that stay Margaret's, and why.
John asks if Margaret's rental can be his: **what do the records show**, and what do you coordinate?

d1m4-l1.hook: The plan is **the file's operating instruction**, and what Atty. Thorne sets strategy from.
points: **Decide acceptance**: Accepted, Escalated or Declined, with a reason
State coverage, liability and projection together; projection **preliminary until coverage confirmed**
Give Clinical, Functional and Financial pillars **measurable goals**
**Flag adverse facts prominently**; a buried risk isn't disclosed
d1m4-l1.upl: State facts, flag risks; legal conclusions, value and posture are Atty. Thorne's
dos: Give each pillar **measurable goals**
Give every decision **a reason others can follow**
donts: A plan that **only covers clinical care**
Gathering more information **at the acceptance stage**
Letting an uncertain file **sit in limbo**

ruleEx.rule: The projection stays **preliminary until coverage is confirmed** in writing
ruleEx.exception: None for value: **no figure ever appears** in a Case Manager's plan
ruleEx.onFile: Three layers named; every limit preliminary until each Dec Page arrives
ruleEx.confirm: Atty. Thorne owns value and acceptance

redFlag.see: A Risks band reading **'none'** for a client nobody has examined
redFlag.costs: A buried risk: no treatment yet, and the days without care keep counting
redFlag.do: List each open risk **with its source and date** in the Risks band

d1m4-a1.situation: John Doe's first treatment records have arrived in the CMS. Find the first treatment date yourself and compare it with **the date of loss**.
steps: Compute **the gap exactly** from DOL to first treatment
Record the gap; **watch for a later break** in care
In the risks band, record **the facts only**: dates and length
List **the documents to request** from John Doe
**Route the flag** to Atty. Thorne
d1m4-a1.deliver: A **precisely computed, prominently flagged** and routed treatment-gap record
d1m4-a1.purpose: Everything after turns on this flag; **an unexplained gap** does more damage
d1m4-a1.principle: Record **exact dates and facts only**; its meaning is Atty. Thorne's
checks: Gap recorded; **a watch set** for later breaks
Risks band: **facts only**, explanation marked pending
Investigation steps: **client's explanation, documents, provider confirmation**
Flag prominent in risks band; **routed to Atty. Thorne**
dos: **Document the reason** for every interruption
donts: Writing **“about two weeks”** instead of exact dates
Recording the gap but **setting no watch** for the next

d1m4-l2.hook: Routing isn't overhead: it's where **operational work becomes authorized work**.
points: Draft in **the section templates**; owner and date in their own fields
**Route for review** before committing the firm's position externally
Address every comment and re-route; run on **the approved version**
Re-route when **a material fact changes**
d1m4-l2.upl: Legal strategy is counsel's: review comments needing legal judgment go to Atty. Thorne
dos: Assume **defense counsel reads every note**
Keep medical notes **factual and clinical**
donts: Edits that **break the audit trail**
Writing **“this will help the case”** in a treatment note

ruleEx.rule: **The file runs against the approved version** of the plan
ruleEx.exception: When a material fact changes, **the plan is superseded** and routed again

redFlag.see: **'This will help the case'** in a treatment note, or a partly addressed plan run
redFlag.costs: Every note is discoverable, and an unapproved plan runs the file off course
redFlag.do: Write facts only; **execute nothing** until Atty. Thorne approves the version

d1m4-a2.situation: The set-up is in: parties mapped, **$40,000 stack verified**, packet tracked, **14-Day Treatment Gap** identified. Atty. Thorne awaits the Case Plan.
steps: Snapshot: record **the acceptance decision** and its reason
Coverage stack and order, liability, **preliminary projection**; triple-check held open
Pillars: **measurable goals**; each action item with owner and date
Risks: **14-Day Gap and later breaks in care**, prominently, with consequences
Docket the filing window, then **route to Atty. Thorne**
d1m4-a2.deliver: A complete, routed plan counsel could **set strategy from** without a follow-up question
d1m4-a2.purpose: This plan is **the gate**: the Treatment Phase doesn't begin until it's routed
d1m4-a2.principle: Report facts and preliminary numbers; **strategy is Atty. Thorne's** to set
checks: Snapshot: DOL 02/06/2026, SOL 02/06/2028, **client a passenger**
Order **BI → Host UM → Relative UM**; projection preliminary
Risks band: **14-Day Gap and later breaks**, with consequences
Plan **routed to Atty. Elijah Thorne** with a timestamp
dos: If counsel must ask a question, **it isn't finished**
donts: A projection stated as a number **before coverage is confirmed**

questions: Set out the **five bands** of the Case Plan and what belongs in each, including the three pillars.
Why has **an adverse fact buried** in a plan's body not really been disclosed to counsel?
State John Doe's coverage as the plan should: layers, limits, total, **order of operations**, projection status.

d1m1-upl.hook: You share **facts and the process**; Atty. Thorne gives every opinion on the case.
points: Legal advice is **any opinion** on what his facts mean
Share facts: dates, documents, **what was sent and when**
Explain the process: **what happens next**, and who decides
Never value, strategy, settlement, or **what the gap does**
d1m1-upl.upl: Hear it, log it, **route it** to Atty. Thorne the same day
dos: Answer from **the record**; route what it means
Use **one routing line**, every time
Give the client **a time frame** for the answer
donts: Reassuring him **about the outcome**
Guessing a value **“off the record”**
Coaching him on **what to tell an adjuster**

ruleEx.rule: Tell John **what is, and what happens next**: facts and process are yours to give
ruleEx.exception: **'What does it mean for me?'** is Atty. Thorne's: 'That's his call; I'll get it to him today.'

redFlag.see: You hear yourself tell John **'Don't worry, you'll be fine'**
redFlag.costs: That is advice: it predicts his outcome, and only Atty. Thorne may
redFlag.do: Stop, log his question word for word, and **route it the same day**

d1m4-tplan.hook: Assess **the whole person** first, or the plan treats a chart and misses the barrier.
points: Assess **four domains**: clinical, social, pre-morbid, vocational
Establish the **pre-morbid baseline**; request prior records, never hide them
Draft **SMART goals**; the provider confirms the measure and date
Map care in four groups; **calendar every transition**
d1m4-tplan.upl: Record and coordinate; diagnosis, treatment and psychological care are the provider's call
dos: Record the assessment **in his own words**, dated
Ask about prior injuries **plainly and early**
Record an empty care group as **“none ordered”**
donts: Building the plan **from medical records only**
A goal like “reduce pain” with **no measure or date**
Calling a prior condition **“unrelated” or “aggravated”**

redFlag.see: A blank field, or a goal like **'reduce pain'** with no measure
redFlag.costs: Blank reads as never asked, and a goal without a measure can't show progress
redFlag.do: Write 'none ordered' or 'not yet on file', dated; **the provider sets the measure**

d1m4-tmap.hook: Know where he **should be on the map**, and you'll see the drift before the adjuster.
points: Locate him every check-in: **phase and week**, counted from the DOL
Not improving? **Name the variance**: clinical, psychosocial or systemic
Measure function: Oswestry/DASH, PHQ-9/GAD-7, FCE; **the provider orders them**
No gain by week 6? **Ask the provider now**, before a denial
d1m4-tmap.upl: You track and ask; **the provider decides care**, Atty. Thorne what it means
dos: Write **phase and week** at the top of every note
Report **what he can't do**, not just diagnoses
Request the objective measures **before the six-week mark**
donts: Letting care drift **with no reason on file**
Calling a systemic delay **client non-compliance**
**Waiting for a denial** before you course-correct

ruleEx.rule: The 6-Week Rule: **20–30% more range of motion or a lower VAS** by week 6 of care
ruleEx.exception: A stop skipped or out of order needs **the provider's documented clinical reason**; you ask and record it
ruleEx.confirm: Provider documents; Atty. Thorne gets the note

redFlag.see: **No visit from 04/02 to 04/21/2026** (19 days), with no reason on file
redFlag.costs: A break off the map with no record of why it happened
redFlag.do: Run **A-C-T the same day**; record his reason and route it to Atty. Thorne

steps.label: Read the records
steps.text: Red flags by specialty: PT, surgery, medication, behavioral health

steps.label: Listen on the calls
steps.text: Yellow flags, written **in his own words**

steps.label: Talk with OARS
steps.text: Open questions, affirmations, reflections, summaries

steps.label: Work the plateau
steps.text: Re-engage him on his goal; ask whether the plan fits

steps.label: Route it

d1m4-tcare.hook: You read every record and hear every call: **spot the flag, route it**, keep him engaged.
points: Red flags by specialty: **PT, surgery, medication, behavioral health**
Yellow flags: fear-avoidance, catastrophizing, litigation stress, **passive-care reliance**
Run every contact on **OARS**; roll with resistance, don't argue
At the plateau, **re-engage on his goal**; it's usually the plan
d1m4-tcare.upl: Report flags; **the provider decides** care; MI is never medical or legal advice
dos: Ask **specific questions**: visits, pain score, function
Write yellow flags **in his own words**, dated
Raise medication facts with the provider, **never as accusations**
donts: **Arguing with resistance**, or warning him about his case
Reporting a yellow flag **with no plan**
Treating late head-injury symptoms **as proof** before validation

ruleEx.rule: **OARS on every contact**: open questions, affirmations, reflections, summaries
ruleEx.exception: **Roll with resistance**: 'That clinic isn't a good fit for you. Let's look at why.'
ruleEx.onFile: His reason went to the provider (Millbrook, 04/22/2026)
ruleEx.confirm: Legal danger goes to Atty. Thorne

redFlag.see: You tell John **'Missing visits will hurt your case'**
redFlag.costs: That is advice about his claim, and it can push him away from care
redFlag.do: Talk logistics and his reasons; **route what it means** to Atty. Thorne

d1m4-emc.hook: On a Florida file, **the EMC rule** decides PIP within days of the accident.
points: Florida PIP: **$10,000**, paying 80% medical, 60% lost income
Initial care **within 14 days** of the accident, or no medical benefits
Only MD, DO, dentist, PA or APRN finds **an EMC**
No EMC: **capped at $2,500**; Riverton has no EMC rule
d1m4-emc.upl: The provider decides the EMC; Atty. Thorne decides what it means
dos: Read **the file's state** before its PIP
Docket **the 14th day** at intake
Log **each provider's credential** beside every visit
donts: Applying **a $2,500 cap** to Riverton's PIP
Treating a chiropractor's note as **an EMC determination**
Telling a client to see a doctor **for the $10,000**

ruleEx.rule: Florida (Fla. Stat. § 627.736(1)(a)): **initial care within 14 days**; without an EMC finding, PIP stops at $2,500 of $10,000
ruleEx.exception: Riverton, add-on PIP: **no 14-day condition and no EMC cap**
ruleEx.onFile: First treatment 02/20/2026; Harbor Point PIP (HP-26-7741) paid its $5,000.00 limit
ruleEx.confirm: The governing statute, and Atty. Thorne

redFlag.see: Telling a Riverton client his PIP is **capped or forfeited** over the 14 days
redFlag.costs: Riverton has no EMC rule: it's wrong, and it is advice about his benefits
redFlag.do: Confirm the governing statute on every file; **route the question** to Atty. Thorne
